scoring_justification: Cannot recompute Seebeck from raw DFT output in the verifier (would require full BoltzTraP solver). The checker reads the agent's reported seebeck_vs_n.json and compares each of six entries against paper-derived hidden gold using tolerances of 20% relative or 30 μV/K absolute (whichever larger). The checker also verifies the physical trend |S(KTaO3)| > |S(BaSnO3)| at all three carrier concentrations. This is a robust T0 result-level compare.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold Seebeck coefficients for BaSnO3 and KTaO3 at carrier densities 1e19, 1e20, 1e21 cm^-3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 5 – digitized numerical values for Seebeck coefficient vs. carrier concentration at 300 K
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from Fig. 5 of the paper (curves for BaSnO3 and KTaO3). The gold matches the reference solve.sh used for oracle QC.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results for Seebeck at the specified points, used as the verification target.

output_contract.notes: Values must be negative (n-type doping). Hidden scoring compares each of the six entries against paper-derived references within a tolerance appropriate for inter-code differences. The trend |Seebeck(KTaO3)| > |Seebeck(BaSnO3)| at each carrier density is also assessed as a structural consistency check.
